The municipal election was Monday, October 26, 2026.
Official Results (/government-and-council/elections/election-results/)

Below is a list of the certified Regional candidates for the 2026 municipal election.

If you live in one of the four Townships, your elected Mayor is your representative on Regional Council.

Regional Chair* (#collapse_a54dbc0b-12d7-458a-9b6a-0a1e9c7371ee_1)                                         Chat

*Following the adoption of the Better Regional Governance Act, 2026, on May 7, 2026 the Regional Chair is nowChat
                                                                                                              a Provincially
appointed position and will not appear on the ballot. No nominations for this position may be filed or accepted. Any nominations
received prior to the passing of the Act are deemed withdrawn.

More information can be found on the Ontario Government’s website at https://www.ontario.ca/page/regional-head-council
(https://www.ontario.ca/page/regional-head-council) . Applications are now closed. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by
the Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing and invited to participate in an interview.
